description: This Perl script acts as a wrapper to facilitate the compilation of Git on Windows using MSVC via GNU Make. It processes command-line arguments to modify and pass them to the 'lib.exe' utility, primarily for handling static library files and build options.

methods.name: main logic of the script (not explicitly named)
methods.description: Processes command-line arguments, modifies them as needed, and executes 'lib.exe' with the constructed argument list.
